data.narrative:
Ultra Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Jon Miller Schwartz, Max Friefeld, Chetan Parthiban, and Oliver Ortlieb. The target has raised $57M+ to date. The robotics and manufacturing sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), though the narrow peer set—particularly companies at identical stage and valuation tier—is constrained.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation approach given data scarcity. Using $57M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields $142M. This single-method approach supports a valuation range of $121M (low) to $164M (high), with a median of $142M.

Key uncertainties include the limited peer dataset and reliance on a single valuation method. The Peer-Median approach proved inapplicable; 11 same-sector robotics peers exist but fewer than three fall within tight stage and valuation-tier filters. A more robust analysis would require either additional comparable data at similar stage and scale, or visibility into recent transaction multiples within the robotics subsector. The $121M–$164M range should be treated as exploratory rather than definitive pending further market data.
